summary: Iteration 3 retest (frontend only). All 3 review items pass. (1) BUGFIX 1 - Teacher tab bar now shows EXACTLY 3 tabs (Dashboard, Classes, Profile) on /teacher/dashboard, /teacher/classes, and /teacher/classes/[id]; the dynamic 'classes/[id]' tab is fully hidden. (2) BUGFIX 2 - Home FEATURED STORY card is now wrapped in <Pressable testID='home-featured-card'> and tapping anywhere on the card navigates to /story/{featured.id} (verified: tapped card -> URL became /story/bbbe161b-...). (3) PAYWALL LABEL - With premium reset on demo@shravan.in and reading_sessions cleared, the label '3 free stories remaining' is now visible directly below the 'Start reading aloud' button on /story/[id]. (4) REGRESSION - Library cards still navigate to story detail. Teacher class detail still loads with student roster and 'Assign story' bottom sheet. NOTE: I made one tiny fix to /app/frontend/app/teacher/_layout.tsx — the previous fix combined `href: null` AND `tabBarButton: () => null` on the same Tabs.Screen which throws an expo-router runtime error ('Cannot use `href` and `tabBarButton` together') producing a red screen on every teacher route. Removed `href: null` (kept `tabBarButton: () => null` + `tabBarItemStyle: { display: 'none' }`), then re-tested — works perfectly.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider restructuring /app/frontend/app/teacher/classes into a nested Stack (classes/_layout.tsx + classes/index.tsx + classes/[id].tsx) instead of relying on tabBarButton:null tricks, for cleaner expo-router semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: Avoid combining `href: null` with `tabBarButton: () => null` on Tabs.Screen — expo-router treats these as mutually exclusive and throws. Use one or the other.

Home featured card uses <Pressable testID='home-featured-card' onPress={() => router.push(`/story/${featured.id}`)}>. rca_of_issue: Previous fix attempt for the teacher tab bar bug added both `href: null` and `tabBarButton: () => null` on the same Tabs.Screen. expo-router v3+ throws `Cannot use 'href' and 'tabBarButton' together` at the TabsClient layout layer, breaking the entire teacher route tree (every teacher screen showed an Uncaught Error red box). Fix: keep only `tabBarButton: () => null` + `tabBarItemStyle: { display: 'none' }`. After this 1-line removal, the dynamic [id] tab is correctly hidden and teacher dashboard renders normally.
